close_reason: Committed as d408f36: 28 handler files across 8 extension-server crates now carry one-line Id::from wire-boundary comment citing JMAP-k9va
description: Skoll review 2026-06-04 probed Id::from( at wire boundaries and dismissed it because the backend returns notFound for unknown IDs. However, none of the 20+ production handler sites (update map keys, destroy array elements, fromAccountId args) have a comment explaining why Id::from is used instead of Id::new_validated. A future reviewer or scanner will re-flag these every time. Fix: add a one-line comment on the first Id::from per handler file citing the tracked migration epic: '// Id::from: wire-boundary validation deferred to JMAP-k9va; backend returns notFound for unknown IDs.' Files: sharing-server (principal.rs, notification.rs), calendars-server (event.rs, event_notification.rs, participant_identity.rs, calendar.rs, principal.rs), contacts-server (addressbook.rs, card.rs), tasks-server (task.rs, task_notification.rs, task_list.rs). Mail-server and chat-server handler sites also exist but were outside the first-20 sample.
title: Add Id::from wire-boundary comments citing JMAP-k9va
